interactiveQuizQuestions.question: Which analog synthesizer gives this synthwave anthem its signature retro warmth?
interactiveQuizQuestions.explanation: Spot on! The Roland Juno-60 with its built-in stereo chorus defined the iconic 80s synth sound.

interactiveQuizQuestions.question: In lo-fi beat production, what technique produces the characteristic vinyl wobble effect?
interactiveQuizQuestions.explanation: Correct! Wow and flutter emulate uneven cassette motor speeds, delivering that nostalgic lo-fi warmth.

interactiveQuizQuestions.question: What standard tempo (BPM) range anchors high-energy electro and French touch tracks?
interactiveQuizQuestions.explanation: Exactly! 124–130 BPM is the legendary four-on-the-floor sweet spot for driving electro house.

faqs.question: Is TuneQuest free to stream?
faqs.answer: Yes! TuneQuest is completely free to listen. You can explore our curated library of tracks, play music quizzes, and earn TunePoints without spending anything.

faqs.question: How do TunePoints work?
faqs.answer: You earn 10 TunePoints for every correct trivia question you answer. You also earn daily streak bonuses for playing consecutive days, plus 100 TunePoints for every friend who joins using your referral code.

faqs.question: What can I redeem my TunePoints for?
faqs.answer: Points can be redeemed in the Rewards Store for VIP passes (ad-free, 320kbps lossless streaming), custom avatar badges, and priority trivia challenge entry.

faqs.question: Can I invite friends and get rewards?
faqs.answer: Absolutely! Share your unique referral code from your profile or the Referrals page. When your friend registers, they receive 50 TunePoints and you receive 100 TunePoints.
